eval_feedback.overall: Strong, efficient baseline -- fastest and cheapest of all 6 runs, and found a genuinely new fact (requirements.txt's ruff pin is disconnected from what CI actually installs) that neither our earlier main-conversation investigation nor the with-skill run surfaced as explicitly. Empirically ran both ruff versions against the real repo tree rather than just reasoning about it.
